flags.why: The example explains what the word means instead of using it to refer to an illness.
flags.fix: Ông mắc trầm kha đã nhiều năm. = He has suffered from a chronic illness for many years.

flags.why: The example unnaturally describes the leaves as climbing the post rather than the vine.
flags.fix: Dây trầu xanh mướt leo kín cột nhà. = The lush green betel vine climbs all over the house post.

flags.why: The pond/lake sense is regional to Quảng Trị and needs a Central tag ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/tr%E1%BA%B1m)).
